name: @story/canvas
comment:exports: Two entries, and the split is load-bearing (VISUALIZER_PLAN §3.1). `.` is the whole library and is React-free; `./react` is the single host component. A consumer that only wants the scene never pulls React in, and the package stays usable from a non-React host.
comment:dependencies: `@story/shared` and nothing else internal (§3.1): this is a rendering library that happens to live in this repo. Konva is the one runtime dependency.
comment:peerDependencies: React is a peer, used only by the `./react` subpath. Marked optional so a non-React consumer installing this package is not told it is missing something it will never import.
